memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Routine follow‑up for PCOS and IBS.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports stable abdominal bloating and occasional loose stools; no new pelvic pain.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 24.1 (overweight). Advised on balanced diet and regular walking. Abdomen soft, non‑tender.
IMPRESSION: PCOS persisting; IBS‑diarrhoea subtype stable. Annual fasting lipids and glucose ordered; PCOS panel and IBS screen requested.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue metformin 500 mg BD, combined oral contraceptive pill OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS PRN. Return if new pelvic pain, worsening diarrhoea with blood, fever >39°C, or chest pain.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting glucose 7.8 mmol/L (3.9‑5.6). HbA1c 6.2% (4.0‑5.6). Lipids: total cholesterol 5.2 mmol/L (<5.2), LDL 3.0 mmol/L (<2.6), HDL 1.2 mmol/L (>1.0), triglycerides 1.8 mmol/L (<1.7). Serum testosterone 3.2 nmol/L (<2.0). LH:FSH ratio 2.5 (<2.0). Pelvic ultrasound: bilateral polycystic ovaries. CBC: WBC 6.2x10^9/L, Hb 12.8 g/dL, Plt 210x10^9/L. Stool routine: no ova, normal consistency. tTG‑IgA <4 U/mL (<7).

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Metformin 850 mg BD; Atorvastatin 10 mg OD; Mebeverine 135 mg BD; Ispaghula husk 5 g OD; Loperamide 2 mg SOS PRN. Combined oral contraceptive pill discontinued.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Review after medication change.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient says bloating improved, occasional constipation; no pelvic discomfort.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 57 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 23.8 (overweight). Advised on fibre intake and gentle exercise. Abdomen soft.
IMPRESSION: Metformin dose adequate; lipids improved; PCOS biochemical markers unchanged clinically. Continue statin.
ARRANGEMENTS: Keep metformin 850 mg BD, atorvastatin 10 mg OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide PRN. Return if constipation >3 days, rectal bleeding, weight loss, or dyspnoea.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Resting ECG: sinus rhythm 78 bpm, no ST‑T changes, left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No evidence of ischemia.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Six‑month review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports occasional heartburn after spicy meals; bowel pattern regular.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/86 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 24.2 (overweight). Advised on low‑fat diet and weight control. Abdomen benign.
IMPRESSION: Stable PCOS and IBS. Annual lipid and glucose repeat due; PCOS markers to be rechecked.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile, fasting glucose, HbA1c, serum testosterone, LH:FSH ratio, pelvic ultrasound. Continue current meds. Return if chest pain, dysphagia, melena, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting glucose 7.2 mmol/L (3.9‑5.6). HbA1c 5.9% (4.0‑5.6). Lipids: total cholesterol 4.8 mmol/L (<5.2), LDL 2.6 mmol/L (<2.6), HDL 1.3 mmol/L (>1.0), triglycerides 1.5 mmol/L (<1.7). Serum testosterone 2.9 nmol/L (<2.0). LH:FSH ratio 2.2 (<2.0). Pelvic ultrasound: ovaries unchanged, no cysts >10 mm.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Winter check‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No new GI symptoms; reports mild joint stiffness in mornings.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 57.5 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 23.9 (overweight). Advised on warm‑up exercises and vitamin D supplement. Abdomen soft.
IMPRESSION: PCOS asymptomatic; IBS controlled. Lipids within target; glucose borderline.
ARRANGEMENTS: Add vitamin D3 1000 IU OD. Continue metformin 850 mg BD, atorvastatin 10 mg OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide PRN. Return if worsening joint pain, swelling, fever >39°C, or unexplained bruising.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Vitamin D3 1000 IU OD added to current regimen.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Mid‑year review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes increased flatulence after lentils; otherwise well.
EXAMINATION: BP 142/88 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 24.2 (overweight). Advised on gradual legume introduction and hydration. Abdomen non‑tender.
IMPRESSION: Stable PCOS; mild IBS exacerbation likely dietary. Lipids and glucose acceptable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Trial of low‑FODMAP diet for 2 weeks; keep loperamide PRN for diarrhoea. Return if persistent pain, weight loss, or rectal bleeding.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve tried reducing beans and my bloating is better. Thank you for the diet tip.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No new concerns; feels energetic.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/90 mmHg, weight 57.8 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 24.0 (overweight). Advised on maintaining activity and monitoring weight.
IMPRESSION: PCOS and IBS well controlled. Annual lipids and glucose within target; no medication changes needed.
ARRANGEMENTS: Influenza vaccine offered and given today 0.5 mL IM. Continue metformin 850 mg BD, atorvastatin 10 mg OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide PRN, vitamin D3 1000 IU OD. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Flu vaccine administered on 2026-09-30; next routine visit scheduled for 2027-02-01.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I received the flu shot yesterday and feel fine. No side effects.
